name: guraneza
description: GuraNeza - Modern online shop based in Kigali, Rwanda

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
